title: John Constable's birth chart
metaDescription: John Constable's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 21.0° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Gemini — the Sun, Venus, Mars and Uranus. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Gemini, but precisely: 21.0°, third decan, 20°–30°, under Saturn in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 15.5° Cancer, Venus at 4.5° Gemini, Mars at 5.2° Gemini. Mercury in a water sign reads as a mind that absorbs before it argues; Venus in an air sign reads as taste led by wit and proportion; Mars in an air sign reads as drive that argues its way forward.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — Venus conjunction Mars, 0.7° of separation. Two bodies in the same degree are not read as neighbours but as a merger: whatever one wants, the other is already funding. Behind it, Mercury square Saturn at 0.9°, and the Sun square Neptune at 1.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These angles were checked through every hour of that civil day and survive throughout, which is why an unrecorded hour does not disturb them.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has two entries for this chart. Jupiter in Cancer at 0.6° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Saturn in Libra at 14.6° is in exaltation. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 5 in air, 2 in water, 2 in earth, 1 in fire by element, 5 mutable, 5 cardinal by modality. Air signs carry exchange in the scheme — comparison, argument, the sentence that makes the situation legible. Saturn and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aries for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.1° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 21.6°.
